translation: Wang Haizang said: The Hand-Shaoyang Sanjiao ministerial fire is one bowel; the right kidney Mingmen is ministerial fire; the Pericardium is also called ministerial fire, and their pulses are examined together. The kidney is the gate of engendering qi; it emerges and governs below the navel, dividing into three branches, ascending and rushing, flanking the navel, passing through Tianshu (ST25), ascending to the u膻u (dan) center between the two breasts, where the primordial qi is attached. Also, the branch of Foot-Taiyang runs together with the proper path of Foot-Taiyang, entering to connect the bladder, and binds below.
